placements.title: System resilience and operational recovery verification
placements.frame: How does the organization structure, practice, and verify its operational recovery and resilience capabilities?

placements.title: Rollback mechanisms exist only when verified through recurring practice
placements.frame: Does the expression treat unpracticed rollback or recovery mechanisms as non-existent operational capability?
placements.why: Connects the monthly Atlas rollback drill mandate with the foundational principle that unexercised recovery capabilities do not genuinely exist.
